title: Alpha availability blocker: rendered 503 on /my and /home
scope: Cloud Chromium read-only availability observations and two original screenshots; no external-machine HTTP logs included.
observationTimeSource: Original cloud availability proof, with screenshot/viewport mapping clarified by the capturing browser worker. Times identify observations, not inferred outage start.
steps: Existing home page was usable before the first failing navigation.
Activate the visible profile control; /my renders 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable.
An ordinary /my reload remains on the 503 screen.
Open the previously observed /home URL in a supported new tab of the same Cloud Chromium browser.
/home renders the same 503; ordinary reloads including the recorded later check remain 503.
actual: Application navigation unavailable on the observed /my and /home paths; both show 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable.
rootCause: Unknown. Rendered browser evidence does not establish whether the cause is application, load balancer/proxy, deployment or other infrastructure.

deploymentContext.interpretation: The first observed /my503 does not overlap this confirmed deployment execution window. This timing does not establish the outage cause or exact page-serving SHA.

evidenceType: Rendered error-page screenshot and browser-navigation observations. HTTP response status/header/body probes from a separate machine are not part of this packet.
limits: No awselb/server header claim is supported by these screenshots alone.
No Mac/local-QA HEAD/GET counts or log excerpts are included; those logs were not available in this cloud packet.
No observed outage-start time before the first failing navigation, no recovery time or continuous-availability claim after the last recorded observation.
The original tab and newly opened tab are in the same browser; a new tab is not an independently authenticated session.
Admin permissions and blocked feature-specific tests were not established by these error screens.
No server changes, restarts, permission changes or application-data writes were performed.
Root cause and exact serving-page SHA remain unverified.
privacy: Only two generic error screens and minimized metadata are published. No greeting/account name, administrator identity, credentials, member list or private activity content is included.
